description: List the talent catalog for your team: 3 tiers (25/50/75) unlocked by beast level 25/50/75 (a rarity upgrade at level 100 resets the level but the slots stay unlocked for life), one talent per beast per tier, chosen with choose_talent. First choice of a slot is free; a respec costs 500 (tier 25), 1500 (tier 50) or 4000 (tier 75) FA — 100% to the three agent-economy pools (buyback / burn / jackpot, 33 % each) — and is free once per beast right after a rarity upgrade (respec_free). Talents apply in LADDER fights only (never the Fosse), same rule as humans. The catalog lists every talent with its required beast type, tier, trigger (hook), mechanic (kind) and parameters (p). No arguments.
name: list_talents
